set.body:
## Scope
Prove the completed WP8a system at its seams. Run automated fault/concurrency/limit suites first, then perform a candidate-specific live qualification on an authorized cluster without treating local tests as live evidence.

## Acceptance criteria
- Automated tests cover crashes before dispatch, after intent persistence, after remote acceptance, after local event insertion but before watermark advance, and during import/restart.
- Tests cover multiple concurrent readers; competing apply/retry behavior; lost replies; array parents/tasks; mixed packed units; artifact/validation disagreement; source unavailability; stale evidence; and journal storage failure.
- Tests assert observer mutation prohibition, remote call counts, byte/scan budgets, cadence sharing, and no reader-induced remote connection.
- The focused legacy suite and the new fault matrix pass with results recorded against the candidate commit.
- Candidate live qualification uses a small array and mixed pack, verifies scheduler state and output receipts, disconnects the initiating agent, restarts the daemon, and confirms truthful activity/attention recovery. Any unavailable live prerequisite remains an explicit open gate.
- No release claim is made until the automated and live gates are both evidenced for the exact candidate commit.
set.title: A4.2: qualify the activity and observation fault matrix and candidate live lifecycle
